description: Read PostgreSQL health, current sessions and blocking locks. For a performance review explicitly request performanceChecks: query_statistics (pg_stat_statements), tables, indexes, vacuum, io. Optional checks use bounded fixed read-only queries and report availability/reasons individually. performanceLimit defaults to 5 rows per sample (maximum 100 or a stricter source limit). performanceOffset defaults to 0; continue each sample using sampling.nextOffset when sampling.hasMore is true, preferably requesting one check at a time. Pages are separate snapshots and may skip/repeat rows as statistics change. Reduce performanceLimit if the response-size limit is reached. Cumulative statistics are not a recent time window. No arbitrary SQL, EXPLAIN ANALYZE, query cancellation or maintenance is exposed.
name: inspect_database
